source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Flutter interface (main.dart, room_page.dart) goes through server_connection_manager and vpn_manager, which use the native VPN plugin. Peer-to-peer network calls go through flutter_rust_bridge to rust/src/api/p2p.rs, and the magic_wall firewall follows the same path to magic_wall.rs.
